title: Monotonicity of good runs
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic machine, $C$ an initial configuration, and $T \le T'$ natural numbers. If every choice word of length at most $T$ leads from $C$ to a configuration satisfying $\mathrm{box}$, and every choice word of length exactly $T$ leads to a halted configuration satisfying $Q$, then the same properties hold with $T'$ in place of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine $N$ and initial configuration $C
Every run of length at most $T$ satisfies $\mathrm{box}$
Every run of length exactly $T$ is halted and satisfies $Q$
